Celine (CS): Kepler dedicated cutover TOMORROW 03:00 UTC. Need owners for: quota verification, staged load, autoscale tuning, and customer comms during the 03:00-05:00 window. Any volunteers?

Noah (Infra): I can own infra handoff + reservation. Pool details: pool-id=kepler-ded-09, template=reserved-a100v4-dense, reserved_slots=7, spare=2. Ill create the reservation and attach the manifest.

Hector (SE): Ill run the staged load tests. Plan: smoke 5m -> canary 15m @ low qps -> ramp 30m -> steady. Need canary key + KMS unseal 02:45-03:15 UTC. Ill post perf snapshots every 5m.

Priya (SRE): Autoscale baseline: min_replicas=3, target_util=60%, max_replicas=12. scale_up_cd=90s, scale_down_cd=240s. Use queue_length as secondary signal with threshold=1400. p95 alert=320ms. Add quick rollback to route 100% back to hosted if error_rate >1.5% for 3m.

Noah (Infra): Reservation commands: ```
redwoodctl reserve create --pool kepler-ded-09 --slots 7 --duration 6h --note "kepler-cutover"
redwoodctl capacity warm --pool kepler-ded-09 --profile cache-warm --concurrency 6
```

scheduler-bot: Load job scheduled: id=1798888888-load for 2026-08-12T03:05:00Z by @Hector. Logs will post to this thread.

Hector (SE): Smoke curl (will swap real token at runtime): ```
curl -sS -X POST https://kepler.api/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer CANARY_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"smoke"}'
```

Celine (CS): Customer asked for a one-time warmup credit and a short post-run feedback call. Ill capture renewal note (health=good but watch latency). Who will post live updates to the customer channel?

Priya (SRE): Ill watch metrics and paste 5-min snapshots. Targets to call OK: p95 < 300ms, error_rate < 0.7%, queue < 1200. If breach -> fallback to hosted as Noah/Priya agreed.

Celine (CS): Great. Pre-run checklist: 1) KMS window confirmed (Noah) 2) Canary key issued (Hector) 3) Reservation created (Noah) 4) Runbook + rollback present (Priya) 5) Billing buffer noted (Celine). DM if blocked. :white_check_mark:
